name: First Baptist Church of Black Mountain

reviews.t: Sweet people and thought provoking service. God is in this place!!! My kids enjoyed kids church too!! They also have a market in the summer every Saturday on the corner of the grounds. They also have vacation bible school for kids in the summer. If you are curious about spiritual things, I would stop in here and ask questions.

The people in the FBC in Black Mountain are warm and caring. They are welcoming and they reach out to the local community in many ways. They embody Christ in their congregation, and as they feed, clothe, send special gifts to meet local needs, to the local community.
People are great. The love us in this place. They do a lot for the community. Needs to change structure (service) in order to attract younger generation.
Very kind congregation. I used to play piano recitals here and visit every now and then when not at my regular Church.
They house the homeless in the basement & it's an all around great church ..
A loving church with a wonderful pastor who truly cares about people!
First Baptist Church of Black Mountain closer to my grandma home.
Very helpful for those with various needs 😀 …
